name: Pace University
description:
Pace University is a private university with its main campus in New York City and secondary campuses in Westchester County, New York. It was founded in 1906 as a business school and has since grown to attract over 2000 international students from over 128 countries to pursue careers in fields such as finance, nursing, and business.

What is the Pace University acceptance rate for International Students?

The Pace University acceptance rate is 87%.

The fitness center enhances students' well-being via classes and first-rate equipment. International students are supported with counseling, health services, career development, and disability services.

Student Life

Over 100 student clubs are registered at Pace University, and the Division of Student Affairs is where students can get involved. The dining options on campus reflect the diversity of the student body, so vegan, gluten-free, vegetarian, and other options are all available to students. Student Development and Campus Activities host involvement fairs each semester, and the Center for Community Action and Research connects students with community events. Entrepreneurship and mentoring programs help students to advance their careers by empowering them with the necessary skills.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value: A range of accommodations is available for Pace University students, including residence halls, apartments, and suites. The accommodation has modern amenities like high-speed internet, laundry facilities, and common areas for socializing and studying. The nearby area provides more privacy for students who prefer to live independently.

highlights.title: Lab
highlights.value: Modern laboratories and classrooms empower students with technological advancement and a range of resources so students can enjoy hands-on learning styles. The libraries have vast collections of print and digital resources, including books, journals, and databases.
